neighbours.label: the word piece after a Latin/Greek number prefix (quadri-ple-gic, quadr-up-lets, hex-ap-od)
fire: The car crash left the young rider a quadriplegic for life.
The hospital celebrated the birth of healthy quadruplets on Monday.
Beetles, ants and flies all belong to the hexapods.
The physicist measured the field of a quadrupole magnet.
Profits nearly quadrupled after the company entered Asia.
Researchers found a stable DNA quadruplex in the promoter region.
Robots with a hexapod design can walk over rough ground.
After the stroke she was diagnosed with quadriplegia.
quiet: The car crash left the young rider with a broken leg for life.
The hospital celebrated the birth of healthy twins on Monday.
Beetles, ants and flies are all common insects.
The physicist measured the field of a bar magnet.
Profits rose sharply after the company entered Asia.
Researchers found a stable DNA hairpin in the promoter region.
Robots with a wheeled design can roll over flat ground.
After the stroke she was diagnosed with partial paralysis.

notes: Card: 'up' x6, 'ple', 'ap', 'ole' inside quadriplegic, Hexapoda, quadruplex, quadrupole. Probe: quadriplegic 0.80, hexapods 0.82, quadruplets 0.60, but 'bilateral' 0.02. Near misses are similar medical/biology words without a number prefix.
